data.title: 德尔塔 · 暖炉沙发旁的撒娇求摸头
data.description: 壁炉火光跳动的温暖起居室内，德尔塔穿着毛绒长衫跪在厚绒毯上，两只犬耳垂下，双手轻轻按在暗影膝头，仰头满眼期待。
data.location: cozy private living quarters with roaring brick fireplace and soft fur rug
data.action: kneeling on a plush rug by a sofa, resting chin and paws on partner knee, looking up with big pleading dewy eyes and drooped dog ears
data.lighting: 壁炉红火光与温馨环境光
data.promptProse: Delta in an oversized fluffy hoodie kneels beside the hearth resting her chin on partner knee, looking up with melting puppy eyes begging for headpats.
data.animaCaption: Flickering firelight casts a cozy glow on her drooped ears and expectant amber eyes.
